artifactPolicy: A shipped target must run the same DSH version as the npm packages. When the publisher has not produced a Desktop build for a target yet, that target is held out of the release instead of pairing new packages with an older host; the hold and its reason are recorded in heldTargets.

heldTargets.mac-x64: dsh-v0.2.2-rc.1 publishes no Intel Desktop build: the mac-x64 feed still advertises 0.2.1-rc.4. Pairing 0.2.2-rc.1 packages with that older host would break the one-version rule, so Intel macOS stays on the previous release until the publisher ships a matching build.
